description: Implementation of TCP socket operations for Windows, including connection management, IO handling, and socket configuration within Chromium's net stack.

classes.name: TCPSocketWin::Core
classes.description: Encapsulates state for ongoing network IO operations, manages event watching, and handles overlapped IO for TCP socket operations on Windows.

methods.name: ReadDelegate::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Handles the event when the read event is signaled, triggering appropriate socket read completion handling.

methods.name: WriteDelegate::OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Handles the event when the write overlapped operation completes, finalizing the write process.

methods.name: TCPSocketWin::Open
methods.description: Creates and initializes a non-blocking TCP socket for the specified address family.

methods.name: TCPSocketWin::AdoptConnectedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing connected socket, setting it to non-blocking and initializing internal state.

methods.name: TCPSocketWin::Connect
methods.description: Initiates a non-blocking connect to the specified address, handling asynchronous completion.

methods.name: TCPSocketWin::DidCompleteConnect
methods.description: Completes the connection process after the connect event is signaled, updating internal state.

methods.name: TCPSocketWin::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket asynchronously, invoking callback upon completion.

methods.name: TCPSocketWin::Write
methods.description: Sends data asynchronously over the socket, handling overlapped IO and callback invocation.
